title: Changing an appointment
instructions: Bay Ross diş hekimi randevusunu değiştirmeye çalışıyor. Önerilen ve kabul edilen saatleri ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: ross
script.text: Hello, this is Peter Ross. I have an appointment on Wednesday at ten, but I can't come. Can I change it?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Of course. Is Thursday morning OK?

script.speaker: ross
script.text: Sorry, I work in the mornings this week. Do you have anything in the afternoon?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Let me see. Thursday at three or Friday at half past four.

script.speaker: ross
script.text: Friday is better. Thursday afternoon I'm picking up my son from school.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: OK, Friday at half past four with Doctor Patel.

script.speaker: ross
script.text: Is it Doctor Patel? Last time I saw Doctor Green.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Doctor Green is on holiday until the end of the month.

script.speaker: ross
script.text: That's fine. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: When was Mr Ross's first appointment?
questions.feedback: İlk randevusu çarşamba saat onda (Wednesday at ten).
questions.evidence: I have an appointment on Wednesday at ten

questions.prompt: Why can't he come on Thursday morning?
questions.feedback: Bu hafta sabahları çalışıyor (I work in the mornings).
questions.evidence: I work in the mornings this week.

questions.prompt: What is Mr Ross doing on Thursday afternoon?
options: picking up his son from school
questions.feedback: Perşembe öğleden sonra oğlunu okuldan alacak.
questions.evidence: Thursday afternoon I'm picking up my son from school.

questions.feedback: Yeni randevu cuma dört buçukta (Friday at half past four).
questions.evidence: OK, Friday at half past four with Doctor Patel.

questions.prompt: Why won't Mr Ross see Doctor Green?
options: Doctor Green only works in the morning.
questions.feedback: Doktor Green ay sonuna kadar tatilde.
questions.evidence: Doctor Green is on holiday until the end of the month.
